instruction: Remove the page numbers from the footer of this document.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully exported the docx document to PDF using File > Export as PDF menu in LibreOffice Writer, keeping the original filename. Completed in 13 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with LibreOffice Writer menus, navigate File menu options, use Export as PDF dialog, handle file save dialogs
metadata.task_rationale: Successful trajectory showed model can navigate Writer menus. This variation tests removing footer content - the document currently has page numbers in footers that need to be removed.
metadata.explanation: Task requires removing page numbers from the document footer. The original document has PAGE field codes in all section footers. Getter reads the docx and checks footer XML for PAGE field codes. Metric verifies page numbers are absent (has_page_numbers=false).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly parses docx footers across all sections and checks for PAGE field codes in XML, which is the standard OOXML representation of page numbers.
Metric correctly handles expected parameter for type='rule' — directly accesses expected.get('has_page_numbers') without incorrectly unwrapping a 'rules' key.
Expected value has_page_numbers=false correctly represents the instruction requirement to remove page numbers.
Postconfig properly saves the document (Ctrl+S + Enter for format dialog) before the getter reads the file, ensuring fresh state.
Complete coverage: the single instruction requirement (remove page numbers from footer) is fully verified by the evaluator.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor: The 'PAGE' substring check in footer XML could theoretically match non-page-number content, though this is very unlikely in practice. A more precise XPath check for w:instrText containing PAGE could be marginally safer.
